composition: centered original head-and-shoulders anime avatar; readable iris motifs; circular-crop safe
creative_direction: Illustrate Giyu Tomioka turning his face back toward the viewer while his shoulders remain slightly angled away. Keep the turn shallow enough that both eyes are fully readable. His dark hair and calm adult features are recognizable, and he wears a plain indigo cardigan over a light shirt for an ordinary indoor moment. Use a detailed animation rendering with pale ivory window light along one cheek, controlled hair strands, and a few careful fabric folds. A small neutral smile softens the expression. Keep the background mostly pale blue-gray, with no furniture or scene-specific objects competing with the face. Give both visible irises clear red patterns and bright catchlights. Behind the shoulders only, add two separate abstract black flame-shaped light ornaments for Amaterasu; they touch and burn nothing. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
style_inspiration: New text-only fan-art composition; no existing frame, panel, promotional artwork or image pixels copied.
